content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user with a task in my to-do list","i_want":"to edit an existing task's title, description, priority and Due Date","so_that":"I can keep the task details accurate, with the same validation as when I create a task","business_description":"Users can update an existing task. Editing uses the same form as task creation, pre-filled with the current values. Editable fields are Title, Description, Priority and Due Date. The same validation as create applies: the title must be non-empty and at most 100 characters, and the Due Date must not be earlier than the Creation Date. The backend stores the change and sets the Last Updated Date. The frontend shows a success or error message and never shows an update as applied before the backend confirms it. Changing the Status is handled by the change-task-status story, not by this story.","business_value":"Users can correct or refine tasks after creation without deleting and re-creating them, and the stored data stays valid under the same rules as create.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"The user opens the edit form, changes the title, and submits the form","then":"The backend stores the new title, sets the Last Updated Date to the time of the update, and the task shows the new title in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task with a valid title, description, priority and Due Date","when":"The user changes the description, priority and Due Date to other allowed values and submits the form","then":"The backend stores each changed value and the frontend displays a success message after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update, the task keeps its previous title, and an error message stating that the title is mandatory is shown"},{"given":"An existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"The user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"An existing task with a title of 100 characters","when":"The user changes the title to 101 characters and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating that the title must be 100 characters or fewer is shown"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns an error","when":"The frontend receives the error response","then":"The frontend does not show the task as updated and displays an error message"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns success","when":"The frontend receives the success response","then":"The frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"An update request has been sent for an existing task and the backend has not yet responded","when":"The edit form is waiting for the response","then":"The task list still shows the previous values for that task and no success message is shown"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"An update request is sent for that ID","then":"The backend returns a Task Not Found error and no data is changed"},{"given":"An existing task with a Last Updated Date of 2024-05-10 10:00:00 UTC","when":"An update request for that task is rejected by validation","then":"The Last Updated Date remains 2024-05-10 10:00:00 UTC"},{"given":"An existing task and an update request with a Priority value outside Low, Medium and High, for example Urgent","when":"The backend validates the request","then":"The backend returns an invalid input error, the stored task is unchanged, and the frontend shows an error message"},{"given":"An existing task and an update request with a Status value outside Open, In Progress and Completed, for example Archived","when":"The backend validates the request","then":"The backend returns an invalid input error, the stored Status is unchanged, and the frontend shows an error message"},{"given":"An existing task and an update request that omits the title field or sends it as null","when":"The backend validates the request","then":"The backend returns a missing mandatory field error, the stored task is unchanged, and the frontend shows an error message"}],"edge_cases":["A title of exactly 100 characters is accepted; a title of 101 characters is rejected.","A Due Date equal to the Creation Date is accepted, because the rule only rejects dates earlier than the Creation Date.","An update request with a Status value is rejected with an invalid input error when the value is outside Open, In Progress and Completed. Status changes themselves are made by the change-task-status story.","An update request for a task ID that does not exist returns Task Not Found and changes no data.","A rejected update leaves every stored field, including the Last Updated Date, unchanged.","Open question: the PRD does not say whether the Description may be cleared to empty on update. This story assumes it can, because the PRD makes only the title mandatory.","Open question: the PRD does not say whether the Due Date may be cleared once set. This story assumes the Due Date is not cleared, because the PRD gives no rule for an empty Due Date."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-list"],"definition_of_done":["PUT or PATCH endpoint for updating a task by ID accepts Title, Description, Priority and Due Date and returns the updated task.","The update endpoint applies the same title and Due Date validation as the create endpoint, and returns an error for an invalid Priority, an invalid Status, or a missing title.","The update endpoint returns Task Not Found for an unknown ID and changes no data.","The backend sets the Last Updated Date only when an update is saved.","The edit form is the same component as the create form, pre-filled with the current values.","The frontend shows a success message only after the backend returns success, and shows an error message on failure.","The task list shows the previous values while an update request is pending.","Automated tests cover every acceptance criterion in this story and pass."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add PUT /tasks/{id} endpoint to update title, description, priority and Due Date","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add an endpoint that updates an existing task by ID. It accepts Title, Description, Priority and Due Date, reuses the create-task title and Due Date validation (title non-empty and at most 100 characters; Due Date not earlier than Creation Date), and rejects an invalid Priority, an invalid Status value, or a missing title with an invalid input or missing mandatory field error. It returns Task Not Found for an unknown ID and changes no data on any error. On a successful save it sets the Last Updated Date to the time of the update. Errors use the simple error handling approach shared with the other endpoints.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-244669c0","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-0b1853d6","R-9dc414dc"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["PUT /tasks/{id} updates Title, Description, Priority and Due Date of an existing task and returns the updated task.","Title empty or longer than 100 characters is rejected with a validation error and the stored title is unchanged.","Due Date earlier than the Creation Date is rejected and the stored Due Date is unchanged.","Invalid Priority, invalid Status or missing title returns an invalid input or missing mandatory field error and changes no data.","Unknown task ID returns Task Not Found and changes no data.","Last Updated Date is set to the update time on success and is unchanged on any rejected request.","Unit or integration tests cover each validation rule and error path."]},{"key_slug":"task-edit-form","title":"[FE] Reuse task form in edit mode with existing values pre-filled","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Reuse the task creation form in edit mode. Pre-fill Title, Description, Priority and Due Date from the current task. Submit the update to the update endpoint. Show a success message only after the backend returns success, and an error message on failure. While the request is pending, keep the task list showing the previous values and show no success message. Do not update the list optimistically.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-9b30a145","R-d57336f7","R-ab9e9cb0","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-0b1853d6"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Edit mode opens the same form as create, with Title, Description, Priority and Due Date pre-filled.","The form blocks submission of an empty title or a title longer than 100 characters and shows the error message.","The form shows the backend validation message when the backend rejects the update.","A success message is shown only after the backend returns success.","An error message is shown when the backend request fails, and the task is not shown as updated.","While the request is pending, the list shows the previous values and no success message is shown.","Component tests cover pre-fill, validation messages, success and error states."]},{"key_slug":"task-update-test-suite","title":"[QA] Add test suite for editing an existing task across API and form","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Build the automated test suite for editing an existing task. Cover the update endpoint, the database effects, and the edit form end to end. Verify every acceptance criterion, including invalid Priority, invalid Status, missing title, Task Not Found, and the no-optimistic-update rule.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-9b30a145","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-d57336f7","R-0b1853d6","R-9dc414dc","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover every acceptance criterion of US-update-task.","Tests confirm stored values and Last Updated Date after a successful update and after each rejected update.","Tests confirm the form shows success only after a successful backend response and error on failure.","Test suite runs in CI and passes."]}]}
